dataset.name: Pediatric acute myeloid leukemia (TARGET-AML)
dataset.description: Public GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq from TARGET pediatric acute myeloid leukemia with an overall-survival contract from diagnosis.
dataset.cohort_context: Pediatric acute myeloid leukemia in TARGET-AML. The molecular population is restricted to primary blood-derived cancer from bone marrow or peripheral blood; normal, recurrent, post-treatment, cell-line and model material is ineligible.
dataset.publication_citation: NCI TARGET Acute Myeloid Leukemia project

metadata.source_program: Therapeutically Applicable Research to Generate Effective Treatments (TARGET)
metadata.sample_selection_note: Bone marrow is preferred to peripheral blood, followed by sample submitter ID, aliquot submitter ID and file ID. One eligible RNA profile is retained per patient.
metadata.excluded_material: Bone marrow normal, blood-derived normal, recurrent blood-derived cancer, post-treatment blood-derived cancer, cell lines and next-generation cancer models.
metadata.treatment_note: Primary blood-derived cancer is a biospecimen class, not proof of treatment-naive status. Prior treatment remains unknown when it is not documented.
metadata.endpoint_note: OS is measured from diagnosis by the GDC survival endpoint. Endpoint-incomplete expression patients remain eligible for molecular analyses but not Survival.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
